mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate broad consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually (INDPRO) indicates supply constraints that pressure corporate margins through input cost inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained CPI inflation above 3.0% annually signals persistent price pressures that trigger equity market risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1,000,000 units annually signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1000.0 (thousand units).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) and employment declines (PAYEMS) below their 3-month moving averages signal labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS above 1.0%) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%.
